_comment: A comb of bandreject notches applied to the /cam publisher's audio in
ffmpeg (see broadcast-api _notch_filters), before any encoder or the
make-up gain. Cleans everything downstream in one place: the HLS Monitor
and the roomaudio WebRTC leg both derive from /cam.
This is a CURATED DATABASE of troublesome signals, built by ear, not
auto-generated. Each entry is one narrowband tone a human identified as a
feedback resonance or whine that is NOT in the room -- it appears only
while the speaker is driven (speaker -> own mic, set ringing by broadband
noise). Every notch is a hole carved in the room's own sound, and a room
monitor exists to hear things, so each records WHY and WHEN.
SEEDED FROM ARIANA (mac-hls-livecam state/notches.json). Ariana's users
found these by ear; ron has heard similar noise on this Linux box and
expects the same feedback loops, so they are carried over as a sane start.
Provisional -- fine-tune later, or from a tuning module. The real fix is
echo cancellation (PipeWire module-echo-cancel on Linux); when that lands,
delete the notches rather than keeping them as insurance.
range brackets are the +/-10 Hz the tone was heard to roam. Ordered by
frequency. Harmonics can be added the same way if they surface -- one
line each, with their own reason.
SoX vs ffmpeg: Ariana runs SoX (bandreject FREQ WIDTHh); Tanzania runs
ffmpeg (bandreject=f=CENTRE:t=h:w=WIDTH). Same numbers, different tool.

notches.note: feedback resonance, 3082 Hz -- ariana's strongest sighting, 39.6 dB above local spectrum (seed: ariana)
